verdict.rationale: OpenClaw has a built-in scheduler that persists automation jobs (openclaw-docs-27). Its architecture page claims 'versioned state' (openclaw-docs-111), and skills are plain SKILL.md directories that can be installed from Git, updated and verified via the CLI (openclaw-docs-17, openclaw-docs-55, openclaw-docs-82), so some versioning is possible through files and Git. Nothing in the pack documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the scheduled automations themselves. Missing for 10: documented version history for automations/cron jobs, a review or diff step before changes take effect, rollback to a prior automation version, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
